statusLine.command: input=$(cat); current_dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); cd "$current_dir" 2>/dev/null; git_branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); git_worktree=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); git_info=""; [ -n "$git_branch" ] && [ -n "$git_worktree" ] && git_info=" | Git: $(basename "$git_worktree")@$git_branch"; used=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); context_info=""; [ -n "$used" ] && context_info=" | Context: ${used}% used"; echo "$(whoami)@$(hostname -s):$current_dir | $(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name') | Style: $(echo "$input" | jq -r '.output_style.name')$git_info$context_info"
